ideas.pitch: An AI-powered graph intelligence platform that detects suspicious retail transactions and flags money laundering patterns in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges faced by people in their everyday lives related to digital transaction fraud and financial security.
ideas.title: FinGuard AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies advanced graph intelligence and explainable machine learning inspired by proven AML winning architectures, appealing heavily to finance and economics judges looking for rigorous risk mitigation.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade agent that combats wrongful insurance and financial claim denials by automatically parsing and matching insurer policy documents.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges faced by people in their everyday lives regarding complex bureaucratic insurance claim rejections.
ideas.title: PolicyShield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent orchestration and rigorous document grounding to solve a painful consumer grievance that every judge or family member has personally experienced.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight HTTP 402 payment gateway enabling real-time micropayments for premium financial data feeds.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges faced by people in their everyday lives in accessing premium financial insights without expensive monthly subscription models.
ideas.title: SolMicroPay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering by cleanly implementing protocol-level HTTP 402 transaction flows, setting the project apart from basic frontend-only apps.

ideas.pitch: A plan-based structured expense management and smart budgeting platform powered by automated virtual card issuing workflows.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges faced by people in their everyday lives around personal financial planning and uncontrolled discretionary spending.
ideas.title: BudgetMate API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles everyday financial discipline with a highly polished dashboard and structured spending rules that judges from the finance society will immediately recognize as practical.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent orchestration framework for automated retail investment research and personalized portfolio management.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world challenges faced by people in their everyday lives when trying to navigate complex financial markets with limited financial literacy.
ideas.title: MarketMind AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs sophisticated multi-agent orchestration that produces comprehensive and structured analytical reports, impressing judges with depth of technical execution.
